boards.title: Your First Weekend at Gannon University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A practical Friday-to-Sunday sequence connecting Gannon landmarks, student spaces, downtown Erie, and Presque Isle.

cards.title: Start beneath the Gannon Arch
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · Stop 1
cards.notes: Begin at the named campus landmark, take an arrival photo, and use the university map to orient yourself before unpacking.
cards.short_summary: A clear visual starting point for learning Gannon’s downtown campus layout.
cards.evidence_claim: Gannon University’s official campus map identifies Gannon Arch as a campus landmark.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus landmark; follow posted campus-access guidance.

cards.title: Learn the student-life hub
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Stop 2
cards.notes: Walk through Waldron to locate its study areas, organization spaces, conference rooms, and dining choices for the semester ahead.
cards.short_summary: A first look at the campus center where studying, events, and dining converge.
cards.evidence_claim: Gannon describes Waldron Campus Center as a student-life hub with study spaces, organization activities, conference rooms, and dining.
cards.access_notes: Campus-building access and dining availability can vary; check posted schedules and carry your Gannon ID.

cards.title: Pause on Friendship Green
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Stop 3
cards.notes: Use this named campus green as a low-pressure meetup point, then identify the nearby library and campus-center routes on the map.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor reset that helps connect the campus map to recognizable landmarks.
cards.evidence_claim: Gannon University’s official campus map identifies Friendship Green as a campus landmark.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; use it during suitable weather and observe posted event or maintenance restrictions.

cards.title: Choose your own Friday dinner
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Stop 4
cards.notes: Compare the independently operated kitchens before ordering, then regroup in the shared seating area near the North Park Row entrance.
cards.short_summary: A flexible downtown dinner stop where each person can select a different kitchen.
cards.evidence_claim: Flagship City Food Hall is a shared downtown space containing independently operated food businesses, common seating, and entrances on North Park Row and State Street.
cards.source_title: Flagship City Food Hall | Downtown Erie, PA
cards.access_notes: Kitchen schedules and offerings vary independently; consult the live hall page before walking over.

cards.entity_name: Nash Library and Student Learning Commons
cards.title: Claim a future study base
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Stop 5
cards.notes: Tour the quiet and collaborative areas, note the study-room options, and identify where you would return for focused or group work.
cards.short_summary: A scouting visit for choosing the right study environment before classes accelerate.
cards.evidence_claim: Nash Library provides quiet and collaborative spaces plus 49 study rooms accommodating groups of two to ten students.
cards.source_title: Nash Library and Student Learning Commons | Gannon University Catalog
cards.access_notes: Semester and break schedules differ; verify current library hours and bring your Gannon ID for services or controlled access.

cards.title: Use your Gannon ID at the museum
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · Stop 6
cards.notes: Bring your student ID for the documented Gannon admission benefit, explore the galleries, and choose one artwork to discuss afterward.
cards.short_summary: A nearby cultural stop with a specifically documented benefit for Gannon students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Erie Art Museum states that Gannon University students, faculty, and staff receive free admission when they present university ID.
cards.source_title: Museum Hours & Directions — Erie Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday through Sunday on the published schedule; closed Monday, Tuesday, and listed holidays. Bring Gannon ID.

cards.title: See Erie from Dobbins Landing
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Stop 7
cards.notes: Walk the public landing, photograph the tower from below, and decide on the observation-deck visit only after checking admission onsite.
cards.short_summary: A bayfront landmark that turns Erie’s waterfront geography into a visible panorama.
cards.evidence_claim: The Port Authority identifies Bicentennial Tower at 1 Holland Street and documents observation decks at 17 and 138 feet.
cards.source_title: Bicentennial Tower | Erie Western Pennsylvania Port Authority
cards.access_notes: The official page lists daily 10 a.m.–9 p.m. hours from Memorial Day through Labor Day; seasonal access may differ.

cards.title: Try one recreation option
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Stop 8
cards.notes: Bring your Gannon ID and choose one manageable activity—track walking, basketball, cardio, or swimming when the relevant area is open.
cards.short_summary: An active campus stop with several indoor options rather than a fixed group plan.
cards.evidence_claim: Gannon states that enrolled students receive facility membership with their university ID; the center includes a pool, gymnasium, track, cardio deck, and courts.
cards.access_notes: Access requires a valid Gannon ID. Facility, pool, and break hours can differ, so check current schedules before visiting.

cards.title: Begin Sunday at the park gateway
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning · Stop 9
cards.notes: Start with the interactive exhibits and 75-foot tower, then use the center’s park information to choose a weather-appropriate route.
cards.short_summary: A structured introduction to Presque Isle before heading farther onto the peninsula.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania DCNR identifies the Tom Ridge Environmental Center as Presque Isle’s gateway and offers free general admission, interactive exhibits, and a 75-foot tower.
cards.source_title: Tom Ridge Environmental Center | Pennsylvania DCNR
cards.access_notes: Visitor center hours are 8 a.m.–4 p.m.; it is open daily April–October and Tuesday–Saturday November–March.

cards.title: Close the weekend beside Lake Erie
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Stop 10
cards.notes: Finish with a shoreline walk or sand volleyball; enter the water only inside an open, designated guarded zone and follow posted rules.
cards.short_summary: A named Presque Isle beach offering a flexible outdoor finale with practical facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Pennsylvania DCNR identifies Beach 6 as Lyons Beach and documents its sand volleyball courts, beach house, changing areas, and restrooms.
cards.source_title: Swimming at Presque Isle State Park | Pennsylvania DCNR
cards.access_notes: Guarded swimming is seasonal and limited to posted hours; never swim outside an open designated guarded zone.
